resources.string: Stops or restarts the app you select through system App info. Selects Power off or Restart on the system power screen at your request. Reads Settings for up to 45 seconds for a stop operation, or only the system power screen for up to 12 seconds for a power action. Only during explicitly started screen capture, for up to two minutes, reads the system window component and handles Back to finish. Does not read screen text or keep process history. Does not record screens or enable itself.
Shows current notifications and their count. No history or content uploads. Access is enabled by the user in Android.
